text:
alex: Quick sync — planning a staggered X + LinkedIn cadence for the product announcement next Tue. Need copy + assets + inbound route by EOD Fri. Thoughts?

sam: +1. I prefer a 2-phase X plan: short thread at 9am PST (headline + metric), follow-up thread at 1pm PST with deeper context and CTA. LinkedIn longform post at 10am PST.

mari: Working on a concise benchmark narrative (latency vs cost) — can send chart and 3-sentence TL;DR. Which metric do we lead with? p95 latency or cost per 1k tokens?

jordan: p95 latency is more attention-grabbing for eng audiences. For execs, lead with unit economics (cost/response). We can A/B headline: "<30ms p95" vs "40% lower inference cost".

emily: For webinar routing: we should open a unique HubSpot form with utm=product_announce and add a hidden field 'source=social'. Then wire into SDR queue 'webinar-inbound'.

sam: Can ops add the webhook? @ops-bot?

ops-bot: webhook created -> https://hooks.example.com/hubspot/xyz. Test payload: `{"email":"test@redwood.com","utm":"product_announce","source":"social"}`

mari: Assets I need: hero GIF (16:9), 1 static thumbnail (1200x628), 3 tweet-stanza variants, and a 300-400 word LinkedIn draft. @design, can you confirm availability?

alex: @design — need those by Thu EOD to QA captions + accessibility text.

design: Can do. GIF draft by Wed. Thumbnails and alt text Thu morning.

jordan: Also share a one-click hook for webinar sign-up on X (use link shortener). Prefer `go.redwood.ai/webinar`. ops, can you ensure redirect + tracking?

ops-bot: shortlink created: https://go.redwood.ai/wv2 (tracks utm_source=social)

sam: Messaging iteration plan: roll Variant A to 30% of impressions (focus on latency claim) and Variant B to 70% (cost claim). Monitor CTR and sign-ups for 4 hours, then switch if one outperforms by >25%.

emily: For engagement follow-ups: SDRs get a daily digest Slack DM with new leads and top 3 engagement signals. @sales, confirm who owns the digest.

sales: @nick will own digest. Nick — can you take it?

nick: I got it. Will triage morning and evening. Prefer CSV format + HubSpot link.

sam: Quick copy picks (working drafts):
- alex: "We reduced inference p95 to <30ms — serving next-gen LLMs, faster. RSVP the webinar: https://go.redwood.ai/wv2"
- alex: "Ship powerful LLM features, not infra. See how we trimmed costs 40% — join our webinar. https://go.redwood.ai/wv2"

mari: I'll QA the claims vs bench. Don't publish until I sign off on the chart + source.

alex: Agree. Also add `#RedwoodInference` + `#LLMops` on X. LinkedIn: no hashtags, keep professional.

sam: Scheduler note: post threads as native X threads (not images of text). Use alt text on images. Emily — do we want paid boost on the initial 2 posts?

emily: Yes — small spend $800 day-of targeted to engineering + product job titles. Set conversion event to webinar sign-up.

jordan: Cool. Let's finalize copy + assets by Thu. If anything slips, push cadence back 48h so design has time.

alex: Thanks all. I'll open a brief Notion checklist and tag people. :thumbsup:
